title: Radiation dose
text: The app adds each day's dosimeter reading to a running total and shows it as a share of the career limit. There is no single-reading colour: the number informs planning, not alarms.
High-rate alarms come from the spacecraft radiation monitor, not from this app. Follow the mission shelter plan on any such alarm.
design_note: Baseline scoring only: no published single-reading limit. Career-limit value follows NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 (see catalog limit_source); no direct standard URL verified.
